dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Kispiox Band Kuldoe 1 reserve on the Skeena River near Kuldo Creek. A reference map is also included as an inset map showing the key plan location of all the reserves in this area. Land cover and features described on the map include a lake [Dam Ganuuxws], a trail from Hazleton to Telegraph Creek, bluffs, and types of timber, soil, and land. Based upon the district name in the plan title, this land was originally part of Cassiar Land District. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1898. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by F. Carter-Cotton, Chief Commissioner of Lands and Works, 24 April 1899.]
